requirements.name: Multi-tenant organization model
requirements.description: The platform shall support multiple legal companies, business units, offices, departments, and projects within governed tenant boundaries.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A tenant can contain a defined hierarchy while preventing unauthorized cross-tenant access.

requirements.name: Organization hierarchy
requirements.description: Every tenant shall maintain a versioned organization hierarchy with effective dates and ownership.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Hierarchy changes preserve history and are visible in audit records.

requirements.name: Role-based access control
requirements.description: The platform shall authorize actions through governed roles and permissions.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every protected action resolves to an explicit permission decision.

requirements.name: Scoped permissions
requirements.description: Permissions shall be scopeable by tenant, company, office, department, project, record type, and owned record where applicable.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Users cannot access records outside assigned scopes.

requirements.name: Segregation of duties
requirements.description: Sensitive workflows shall support incompatible-role and dual-approval controls.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Configured conflicts block or route the action for independent approval.

requirements.name: User lifecycle governance
requirements.description: User invitation, activation, suspension, termination, and restoration shall follow controlled lifecycle states.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Disabled users immediately lose interactive and API access while history is retained.

requirements.name: External user governance
requirements.description: Customers, vendors, subcontractors, consultants, and partners shall be represented as restricted external identities.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: External access is limited to explicitly shared records and portal capabilities.

requirements.name: Policy management
requirements.description: The platform shall support versioned policies with owners, effective dates, applicability, acknowledgment, and supersession.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Only one applicable active version is effective for a given scope and date.

requirements.name: Configuration governance
requirements.description: Enterprise, tenant, company, office, project, and user configuration shall be layered with declared precedence.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The effective value is reproducible and shows its source layer.

requirements.name: Approval framework
requirements.description: The platform shall provide configurable approval policies based on object, amount, risk, scope, role, and condition.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Approval outcomes are immutable, attributable, timestamped, and auditable.

requirements.name: Delegation of authority
requirements.description: Authorized users shall be able to delegate approval authority for a defined scope and time period.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Delegation never exceeds the delegator's authority and preserves attribution.

requirements.name: Audit trail
requirements.description: Material creation, access, change, approval, export, AI action, and administrative events shall be recorded in tamper-evident audit records.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Audit events contain actor, action, object, time, source, before/after reference, and correlation identifier.

requirements.name: Data classification
requirements.description: Records and fields shall support governed data classifications and handling requirements.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Classification drives access, export, retention, masking, and monitoring controls.

requirements.name: Retention and legal hold
requirements.description: The platform shall apply retention schedules and legal holds without destroying required evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Legal hold overrides ordinary deletion and retention expiration.

requirements.name: Record lifecycle
requirements.description: Governed records shall use explicit lifecycle states including draft, review, approved, active, suspended, superseded, archived, and deleted where applicable.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Invalid state transitions are blocked and valid transitions are audited.

requirements.name: Change control
requirements.description: Locked specifications, policies, configurations, and master data shall change only through governed change requests.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Approved changes include impact analysis, effective date, version increment, and rollback plan.

requirements.name: AI access governance
requirements.description: AI agents shall inherit explicit data and action permissions and shall not bypass user or system authorization.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every AI tool action is authorized, logged, and attributable to an agent and requesting context.

requirements.name: AI writeback approval
requirements.description: AI-generated changes to governed records shall create proposals unless an approved automation policy permits a narrower action.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Proposal, reviewer, decision, evidence, and final writeback are traceable.

requirements.name: Administrative console
requirements.description: Authorized administrators shall manage organizations, users, roles, permissions, policies, configuration, approvals, retention, and audit from a governed console.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Each administrative surface enforces permission, validation, and audit requirements.

requirements.name: Emergency access
requirements.description: Break-glass access shall require justification, limited duration, elevated logging, notification, and post-event review.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Emergency access expires automatically and produces a review case.

requirements.name: Session and device governance
requirements.description: The platform shall support session, device, location, and authentication-risk policies.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: High-risk sessions can be challenged, restricted, or terminated.

requirements.name: Tenant provisioning
requirements.description: New tenants shall be provisioned from versioned templates with region, units, currency, language, industry packs, and policy defaults.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Provisioning creates a reproducible deployment record and validation report.

requirements.name: License and entitlement management
requirements.description: Capabilities shall be controlled through plans, entitlements, feature flags, limits, and effective dates.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized or expired capabilities are inaccessible without data loss.

requirements.name: Notification governance
requirements.description: Governance events shall notify required owners, approvers, security personnel, or affected users based on policy.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Notifications are deduplicated, logged, and escalated where required.

requirements.name: Governance reporting
requirements.description: The platform shall provide governance dashboards and reports for access, approvals, policy status, audit, retention, exceptions, and administrative changes.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Reports reconcile to authoritative governance records and respect access scope.
